parity.source_fences: Every new positive and executable negative receipt records unchanged before/after Wasm, driver, dependency, selected compiler, native effects, resource map and actual executable image hashes. No further arithmetic/LEB/lifecycle issue was found for this profile.
parity.controls_first_attempt: A control harness initially selected an absent Bun path and refused at spawn. That failed command record is retained. The final harness uses the inherited PATH and preserves SDK result files separately from command receipts.
